title: Anh ơi — Getting a waiter's attention

segments.script: [EN: Warm up.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Very delicious!] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Ngon quá!] [EN: Speak slower.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Nói chậm hơn.] [EN: What time?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Mấy giờ?] [EN: Supermarket.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Siêu thị.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Tiền thối.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Change.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: You want to call a waiter. You already know the pronouns for an older man and an older woman. Add a calling word.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Ơi.] [EN: This little word calls out to someone. Use it right after a pronoun. To call a man.] [VI_M: Anh ơi!] [EN: Call a man.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Anh ơi!] [EN: To call a woman.] [VI_M: Chị ơi!] [EN: Call a woman.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Chị ơi!] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: To say wait a moment, say] [VI_F: Chờ một chút.] [VI_F: Chờ] [EN: has a falling tone.] [VI_F: Chút] [EN: has a high, rising tone.] [EN: Say wait a moment.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Chờ một chút.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Drill. Excuse me, to a man.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Anh ơi!] [EN: Excuse me, to a woman.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Chị ơi!] [EN: Wait a moment.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Chờ một chút.] [EN: Excuse me, give me the bill.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Anh ơi, cho tôi hóa đơn.] [EN: Now reverse.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Chờ một chút.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Wait a moment.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Chị ơi.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Excuse me, to a woman.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_M: Chị ơi!] [VI_F: Dạ, chờ một chút!] [VI_M: Cho tôi hai ly nước.] [VI_F: Dạ liền.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now you try. Call a woman.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Chị ơi!] [EN: Ask her to wait a moment.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Chờ một chút.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Tomorrow a dish is sold out. The preview phrase is] [VI: hết rồi] [EN: which means sold out.]
